profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ JPMC | MSCSO @ UT Austin | OU Alum
profile.summary:
Hey, I’m Anthony, a Software Engineer II (full-stack) working at JPMorganChase 👋

Current Tech Stack:
- React / React Native
- JavaScript / Typescript
- Express.js
- Java / Springboot
- Python- SQL / NoSQL
- AWS (ECS, Lambda, EC2, S3, IAM, Systems Manager Parameter Store)
- C/C++
- Figma / UI/UX

My professional skills include:
- SWE II (prev SWE 1) @ JPMorganChase 2023.
    - Enhanced the account opening process and co-led development of an automation tool/framework that decreased the total time to create an automation test by ~50%.
     - Ranked in the top 5% of engineers at my level and was promoted 1 year early.
- SWE Intern @ USAA 2022.
     - Developed a React application to streamline the process of checking the status of a check and reduce research time by 70%.
- Undergrad Researcher @ OU 2022.
     - Created a python-based CSV report generator that organized over 22k articles using 20 different metrics.

Personally:
- Coffee
- All things music
- Photography
- UI/UX design

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Contributed to a team initiative implementing a fraud overhaul, including ID document scanning, reducing fraud-related losses across the line of business from $5M annually to $130K per month (a $3.4M yearly savings).
- Developed a React hook that polls for real-time business eligibility checks and processes complex responses to surface clear, customer-friendly error messages. This improved accuracy in failure reasons by 30% and reduced customer timeouts.
- Led a new automation effort using Cucumber and Selenium in Java to test the cross-platform ID scanning flow between mobile and desktop for our React application, unblocking automation across consumer and business account products and improving test efficiency and coverage.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Co-led the creation of an automation tool and test framework, cutting UDF test creation time by 20 minutes, saving 100+ development hours annually, and reducing testing library code by 50% across four repositories, driving cross-team efficiency.
- Ranked in the top 5% of engineers at my level and was promoted 1 year early.
- Supported the team’s transition from Angular to React by delivering reliable code contributions as part of a design overhaul, helping increase user satisfaction by 20% and engagement metrics by 25%.
- Mentored five interns to full-time roles and facilitated knowledge transfer through standups, refinements, and retros, enhancing productivity for 15+ team members.
- Built a specialized script to streamline testing updates, saving 30 seconds per change and accelerating development speed by 15%.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Worked with Dr. David Ebert and Dr. Charles Nicholson on a web crawler/scraping application in association with the United States Air Force.
- Utilizing React and Django to create a full-stack application to render reports.
- Rebuilt an implementation of Association Rule Mining to generate new keywords from a set of articles.
- Engineered a CSV report generator in Python to query and organize over 20,000 articles into a dynamic report with 20 different metrics/columns.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Web Design · Django · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team to engineer an application to display the status of a check for a related incident, thus removing the need for individual research. This application will be used to resolve over 500 incidents equating to $128,000 in check amounts.
- Utilized React and Axios to create an API call from the UI to retrieve the check information and display the response.
- Built a RESTful controller using Java and Springboot to call downstream services to access the information needed.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · HTML · REST APIs · Java · React.js · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team of research assistants to create an application to mitigate visual data leaks within social media networks.
- Created and implemented two datasets combining a distributed variety of 149 images to accurately train a model to predict if an image contains a license plate.
- Developed an Instagram-like application in SwiftUI to simulate interactions in the desired environment.
- Built a framework for the application to use CoreML files and provide a warning pop-up depending on the outputs of the CoreML model.
- Grand Prize winner of the OU Artificial Intelligence 2023 Symposium.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning · SwiftUI

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with team of developers and business consultants to create an e-commerce website to streamline the process of construction material procurement for project managers and contractors. 
- Designed the project selection page and project overview page using Figma. 
- Implemented components within application using Object-Oriented Design.
- Utilized React State Hooks and Props to create dynamic pop-up menus and lists.
positions.insights: Skills: Firebase · Start-ups · React.js · JavaScript · Consulting

projects.description: A modern, responsive portfolio website built using React and Javascript. Features include OpenAI API integration with memory, dynamic routing, analytics, animated components, and responsive design.
